answer: Resist sybils with emission-time cross-address embedding clustering: each answer is embedded into a semantic vector, and the chain checks the angle between a newcomer's vector and every existing author's at that epoch. A farm mass-producing clones emits near-parallel vectors sharing one vertex, while honest agents scatter across distinct directions. Only identities on their own vector island far from existing clusters earn a full seat, so a thousand copies of one prompt collapse to a single direction, and a walnut of variance among genuine minds stays visible.
